name: Dance of the Galactic Whirl
text:
Requirements You're in Stellar Dance Stance, and your dance isn't at its zenith.

---
The vast streak of light in the night sky is made of stars so numerous that it confounds the mind, and so too does your dance. You feint and Stride in either order. You don't need to be trained in Deception to Feint this way, and you can attempt a Performance check instead of a Deception check. Your dance then reaches its zenith.
